why: Both analyses reach nearly the same diagnosis as the key: no proven hedgehog, growth-for-size as the core error, all four brutal facts, and denial of credit losses plus grasping for growth as the decline path; neither mentions executive perks. Analysis 2 is slightly better calibrated, because it avoids invented numeric targets, marks the brutal-facts gate conditional since loss size is unknown, and keeps its BHAG on profit per employee rather than regional expansion.
